## Open

### T-161 — The rest-fs extension sends colour it cannot honour

> _2026-09-27 · ext/rest-fs · open_

Gaps found while documenting the server half. Rename and copy accept an overwrite field the client
sends and the server never reads, so overwriting an existing target fails instead of replacing it.
The provider's watch() is a no-op, so the mounted tree does not follow changes made on the server.
The URI handler opens restfs:/path and drops the authority, which indexes the workspace map by the
empty string. The extension's own instructions told readers to send HTTP Basic credentials while the
server implements auth false or jwt only, and the quick-start showed a flat restfs.baseUrl where the
code reads the workspace map keyed by name; both documents were corrected while the F4 post was
written, and the three behaviour gaps remain.
